lines.zh: 我横着走，沙被拨开两边。
lines.en: I walk sideways, pushing sand both ways.

lines.zh: 八条腿敲着沙面，很轻快。
lines.en: Eight legs tap the sand briskly.
I carry a little coral as I go.
Live coral branches grow on my shell.
I scuttle sideways along the tide line.
A wave pushes me; I push back.
My claw picks up a shell.
I dig in, showing only my eyes.

lines.zh: 脚在湿沙上留下细密的小孔。
lines.en: My feet leave a comb of holes in the wet sand.

lines.zh: 我绕过一块礁石，慢慢来。
lines.en: I work around the rock, slowly.
The coral on my shell knocks softly.
I head for shallower ground.
A shadow passes; I freeze.
My right claw is bigger than my left.

lines.zh: 沙子进了关节，我抖了抖。
lines.en: Sand gets in my joints; I shake it out.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开你踩下的脚。
lines.en: I sidestep your descending boot.
I lift my claws and wait.
My eyes turn on short stalks.
The wave pulls back; I lower myself.
I'm cleaning the silt off my shell.
The coral on my back opens slowly.
I watch a small crab pass.
Water keeps moving through my gills.
I bring a claw to my mouth.
Something moves on the sand.
I hold my ground and don't retreat.
A wave sounds far off.
I move one foot.
My shell is hot in the sun.
A fish in the shallows is watching me.
You're standing on my sand.
I raise my claws to warn you off.
My eyes swivel toward you.
Are you after my coral?
I sidestep back one pace.
Don't bend down; I nip.
There's sea water on your boots.
Good, you're standing away from the tide line.
I study you for a moment.
There's something in the sand; it's mine.
A tooth is missing from my claw.
I sidle back a long way.
My claw goes up, then down.
That made me rock.
My joints ache.
A branch of coral falls off.
I draw in a little closer to my shell.
Water seeps into the crack.
I watch you with claws open.
I haven't backed off far.
That smells of fish.
Put it down and step away.
The smell makes my claws tremble.
Better than a shell.
I test it with a claw tip.
Don't hold it in your hand.
I pinch it; the grip is firm.
A fresh taste of the sea.
Put it a bit farther.
I sidle over, very slowly.
You touch my shell.
My claw knocks against you.
I sidestep away awkwardly.
We collide and sand flies.
This rock juts out too far.
You stepped on one of my legs.
I brace and don't get pushed.

lines.zh: 我的珊瑚碰掉了一小枝。
lines.en: A small coral branch breaks off.
Step back and I'll crawl over.
It didn't hurt, but it was loud.
She carries coral too.
We tap claws together.
Her shell is redder than mine.

lines.zh: 我用钳把最圆的贝壳给她。
lines.en: I nudge the roundest shell her way.

lines.zh: 她的钳子碰了碰我的钳子。
lines.en: Her claw taps mine.
She digs into the sand; I follow.

lines.zh: 潮水把我们盖住，又退下。
lines.en: The tide covers us, then withdraws.
I take a wave for her.

lines.zh: 我们背上的珊瑚碰到一起。
lines.en: Our corals touch.
She edges away and looks back at me.
I pinch a piece of broken coral.
This colour is right.
I carry it with both claws.
There's something in the shell.
I tuck it into a sand hole.
This little fish is still moving.
Carrying it, I move slowly.
Too heavy; I drag it.
This one's empty.
I'll store the big one first.
The sand is moving over there.

lines.zh: 我把两只钳子张到最大。
lines.en: I open both claws wide.
I close in sideways.

lines.zh: 它踩着我的沙，还没觉察。
lines.en: It walks the sand, unaware.
I fix on its legs.
The tide covers my approach.
I press my shell down onto the sand.
Two steps of distance.
I need this pinch to land.
My legs creep toward it, inch by inch.
I track it sideways.

lines.zh: 我横着跟住它，一步不落。
lines.en: I track it sideways, never a step behind.
Its trail in the sand is clear.
I make no sound.
My claws stay open.
It backs to the reef; good.

lines.zh: 我算好了两条腿之间的空隙。
lines.en: I've measured the gap between its legs.

lines.zh: 我数着它的脚落下的节拍。
lines.en: I count the beat of its feet.
The wave comes; now.
I've got it in my grip.
I pinch and it flinches.
The other claw follows.
I drag it into the sand.
Shell on shell, brittle.

lines.zh: 我的钳滑了，只夹到壳沿。
lines.en: My claw slips and only catches the rim.
I caught a joint.
The sand is all stirred up.

lines.zh: 我第二夹落在它的关节上。
lines.en: My second pinch lands on its joint.
It flips; I hold it down.
I open my claws and watch.

lines.zh: 沙滩上多了一小丛活珊瑚。
lines.en: A small living coral appears on the beach.
I push out of the wet sand, eye stalks first.

lines.zh: 潮水刚退，留了我在这里。
lines.en: The tide just left, and there I was.

lines.zh: 我背上的珊瑚还挂着沙。
lines.en: Sand still clings to the coral on my back.
The smell of the sea; good.
The surf stranded me on wet sand.
My eyes turn all the way around first.
The sun glints on my shell.
This beach hasn't seen me before.
I pinch a grain of sand and let go.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我壳上的珊瑚全焦了。
lines.en: Fire scorches the coral on my shell.

lines.zh: 我摔在硬沙上，壳响了一声。
lines.en: I hit hard sand; my shell clacks.

lines.zh: 水一下子太多，我翻了过来。
lines.en: Too much water at once; I flip over.

lines.zh: 炸响把我掀得四脚朝天。
lines.en: The blast tips me onto my back.

lines.zh: 一根尖东西插进我的缝隙。
lines.en: Something sharp goes into a seam.

lines.zh: 有股力量把我按在沙上。
lines.en: Force presses me into the sand.
My shell's empty and my legs are weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我的眼睛白了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits; my eyes flash white.
No sand; my feet find nothing.
